entities.name: Cēzars Ozers
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Cēzars Ozers, also known as Tsezar Eduardovich Ozers, was a Soviet and Latvian basketball player. He played as a point guard. Ozers won a silver medal at the 1960 Summer Olympics. He died on 5 November 2023, at the age of 86.
